title: From Word Sequences to Behavioral Sequences: Adapting Modeling and Evaluation Paradigms for Longitudinal NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance on random document-level splits versus cross-sectional splits (evaluating on unseen individuals) to measure performance inflation caused by models memorizing author identities and stable person-level idiosyncrasies rather than generalizing.

Comparing model performance on random document-level splits versus prospective splits (evaluating on unseen future time periods) to detect performance inflation from training on future observations and failing to capture true within-person dynamics.
